title: Which fixed-rate pool a Pittsburgh regional bank's one $1.2 billion four-year pay-fixed swap overlay is designated against, ranked on the +200 basis point loss in economic value averaged over the swap's first year, when the 2023-24 mortgages lose most on last year's speed and most of the commercial real estate balloons due in 2027 cannot be refinanced at the planning cycle's rate
subdomain: stress-testing-capital (interest-rate risk in the banking book: each fixed-rate pool's +200 bp loss in economic value through the swap's first year, on base-case cash flows that need each pool's behaviour forecast: mortgage prepayment at the planning rate, commercial real estate balloons extended by their refinance cover)
prompt_shape: a committed designation (one of five pools) with its averaged +200 bp loss to the nearest $10 million, a table of the hedge programme's notional in effect at each 2027 quarter-end for its overlays, funding hedges and loan hedges, and a two-slide ALCO deck charting it
